modelName.title: Model Name
modelName.description: The name of the model to be used from this provider

apiType.title: API Type
apiType.description: Defines the type of API to be used with this model

apiStack.title: API Stack
apiStack.description: Optional backend API preset advertised in the model's api block (/healthcheck and pong models); it never selects the adapter. Its transport must match apiType: openai for every preset except anthropic, which requires claudeai. Trimmed and lowercased on load; an unknown preset or a mismatch is logged and ignored for that model (its backend API is then detected at runtime, as if apiStack were omitted). When omitted, the backend API is detected at runtime by probing the backend's service endpoints (never inference requests; one hop through LiteLLM) and reported with source: detected; MODEL_API_DETECT_ENABLED=false turns detection off.

modelFamily.title: Model Family
modelFamily.description: Optional canonical model family used to pick reasoning-control bindings. Families with bindings: qwen3, qwq, deepseek-v3.1, deepseek-r1, gpt-oss, glm, granite, hunyuan, seed-oss, nemotron, claude, o-series, gemini, gemma (Gemma 4 members only), kimi (K2.5 / K2.6 hybrid; K2 Thinking, K2.7-Code and K3 always-on), minimax (MiniMax-M2 and M2.x always-on; MiniMax-M3 hybrid via thinking_mode; Text-01 and M1 none), exaone (EXAONE 4.x hybrid; EXAONE Deep always-on). For gemma, kimi, minimax and exaone the member is detected from modelName, so modelFamily alone does not select those bindings. Any other value (or an inferred label such as llama, mistral, phi) is accepted and reported as modelFamily without reasoning bindings; inferred from modelName when omitted. Runtime detection never overrides an explicit value; it only fills an empty one.

apiUrl.title: API URL
apiUrl.description: The URL of the API to be used with this model. Full url including endpoint.

parameters.title: Configuration parameters for model
parameters.description: Optional parameters that can be passed to model

concurrentSlots.title: Concurrent Slots
concurrentSlots.description: The number of concurrent slots to be used with this model

capacityPolicy.title: Capacity Policy
capacityPolicy.description: The policy to be used for capacity management

capabilities.title: Declared capabilities
capabilities.description: Optional facts about the model as served, published in the model's api block (capabilities.*) with evidence "declared". Each declared field wins over the detected or registry value for that field; other fields are still filled by detection. Applied to every chat-transport model whether apiStack is set or detected. An invalid block (unknown key, wrong type, non-positive integer, unknown modality or structured kind) is logged and ignored for that model; the model itself is kept.

context.title: Context window
context.description: Served window in tokens (prompt + completion), e.g. the vLLM --max-model-len or llama.cpp -c value; the number consumers plan requests against.

tools.title: Tool calling
tools.description: Function/tool calling accepted by the backend for this model.

webSearch.title: Web search
webSearch.description: The backend can search the web for this model on request; the request knob is a web_search.* binding.
